card.name: Direction or manner words after verbs
card.fires_on: Short adverbs of direction, place or manner such as home, back, way, overhead or later. They come right after a verb or a phrase like "this" or "minutes" in general prose.

modes.description: The adverb home or back follows a verb of travel or sending, or a distance.
modes.example: traveled back<< home>> to Salt Lake for the fall and winter
